headline.zh: 天钥桥路小而全的手冲+意式社区店
headline.en: Small but full-service hand-drip & espresso cafe

traits.zh: 临街整面落地玻璃窗，可见内部吧台
traits.en: Full-height street-facing glass window with visible bar

traits.zh: 提供瑰夏手冲、冰美式、Dirty、生椰拿铁
traits.en: Offers Geisha pour-over, iced Americano, Dirty, and coconut latte

traits.zh: 供应贝果、巧克力棒（Pocky）和瓶装饮料
traits.en: Serves bagels, Pocky chocolate sticks, and bottled drinks

traits.zh: 室外两张折叠椅加储物箱，有室外座位
traits.en: Two foldable chairs and a storage box outdoors; outdoor seating available

focus.zh: 营业至18:00，非深夜办公时段

linger.zh: 有室外座位，可短时停留

adventure.zh: 提供瑰夏手冲及多种创意特调
adventure.en: Geisha pour-over and multiple signature drinks
